tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// lung rigs rnam dag dang mthun par 'chad dgos tshul bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// mkhas pa rnams las sde snod mang thos shing*// blang dor legs par 'byed pa'i blo gros can// tshul khrims legs srung lta ba dag pa can// kun dga'i ming can dge slong 'di skad smra// shākya seng ge'i bstan pa ni// 'phags pa'i yul na rab tu gsal// de nas gangs ri'i khrod 'di ru// skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyis bsgyur// dang po dag cing dar ba las// deng sang phal cher nub par gyur// de dag gsal bar byed 'dod pas// bdag gis sgra dang tshad ma dang*// snyan ngag sdeb sbyor tshig gi rgyan// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi// phyi dang nang gi grub pa'i mtha'// yongs su grags pa phal cher thos// thos pa de dag legs pa sbyangs// grub mtha' 'khrul dang ma 'khrul pa'i// rnam par dbye ba mkhas pas mdzad// de yi rjes su bdag gis kyang*// lung dang rigs pas cung zad dpyad// mu stegs byed kyi rtog ge la// rdzas dang bye brag yon tan spyi// 'brel pa la sogs don la 'dod// bod kyi rtog ge ba rnams kyang*// phal cher de ltar 'dod pa yod// de dag bdag gis legs par bkag /de bzhin 'dul ba'i sde snod dang*// pha rol phyin pa mngon pa dang*// rnam rig dbu ma'i gzhung lugs dang*// gsang sngags rgyu sde bzhi po la// 'khrul par 'chad pa mang du thos// thog mar skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te// so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang*// sems bskyed dang ni dbang bskur la'ang*// mdo rgyud dang ni mi mthun pa'i// cho ga mdzad pa cung zad mthong*// rim pa gnyis kyi ting 'dzin dang*// ye shes phyag rgya chen po dang*// rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs kyi// phyi dang nang gi rten 'brel dang*// sa dang lam gyi bgrod tshul la// thub pa'i gsung dang mi mthun pa'i// rnam par bshad pa 'ga' zhig mthong*// de 'dra'i lugs kyi grub mtha' la// de dag 'thad dang mi 'thad ces// lung dang rigs pas rnam par dpyad// de la 'ga' zhig legs zhes zer// 'ga' zhig mi 'thad ces su smra// 'on kyang 'thad dam mi 'thad pa// shes rab ldan pas legs par dpyod// gal te rigs pas 'thad na blang*// de lta min na dor bar bya// len yang lung dang rigs pas blang*// lung yang nges don tshad mar gzung*// drang ba'i don la yid ma rton// rigs pa'ang dngos po stobs zhugs gzung*// rigs pa ltar snang snying po med// de ltar dgongs pa brtags nas ni// blang dor byed pa mkhas pa'i lugs// mu stegs gzhung dang rgan po'i lugs// gcor byed blun po'i rnam thar yin// skye bo dam pas dam pa'i chos// chos lugs dam pa gzung bar bya// de ltar byas na dam pa'i chos// dgongs pa dam pa 'grub par 'gyur//

//des na bdag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mdo rgyud dri ma med pa lung dang rigs pas grub pa/ mkhas pa rnams kyis bshad pa/ grub thob rnams kyis bsgom pa/ 'phags pa rnams kyis bgrod par bya ba 'di bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gsung dang mthun zhing lung dang rigs pas 'di ltar 'thad ces bshad kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i yid kyis bshad pa ma yin no// des na thams cad kyis bdag gis bshad pa 'di/ lung dang rigs pa dang mthun mi mthun gzu bo'i blos dpyad par zhu/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas sbyar ba 'di re zhig rdzogs so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
